violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: housemade crab dip removed from the walk in freezer (not relabeled with new hold date, remaining 5 days).
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: CFM relabeled the housemade crab dip with new discard date (5 days remaining).

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: sliced yellow cheese wrapped in plastic wrap inside the Continental 2 Dr UR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. CDI: CFM discarded undated sliced wrap cheese.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed ice bin that have been cleaned not stored covered or inverted on prep counter near ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. CDI: CFM washed, rinsed, and sanitized ice bin and stored inverted on clean food contact surface.

violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: Ranch , Butter, different Cheeses in the Saturn 1 DR refrigerator and the 2 DR Continental refrigerator were observed to have date marking between May 5th and May 22nd.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed with the Person In Charge. All items that had expired date marking were discarded during the inspection. PIC will train and designate a staff member to check and monitor date marking of TCS food items at the facility Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine.
